utility.notes: TID is a publicly-owned (municipal) electric utility serving Turlock, distinct from PG&E. Confirmed via TID's own rate-schedule materials for customers installing solar/self-generation facilities within the Turlock Irrigation District service area, and TID's own 'Go Solar' program page.

value.name: Turlock Irrigation District (TID)
value.notes: TID is a vertically-integrated municipal utility (also providing irrigation) — it generates/procures and delivers its own power rather than sitting alongside a separate CCA, consistent with the pattern already established for MID, SMUD, and Roseville Electric this session. TID notably does not allow virtual net energy metering (VNEM), requiring a separate PV system per dwelling unit for multi-unit properties.

permit_authority.value: City of Turlock Building & Safety Division

interconnection_url.notes: TID's own 'Go Solar' program page, identified via search-engine indexing; not independently fetched this session.

battery_programs.notes: The statewide SGIP program (administered by the CPUC-regulated IOUs) does not apply to TID customers, since TID is a municipal utility outside CPUC jurisdiction, consistent with other municipal-utility records this session.

value.notes: The City of Turlock issues a permit number within 24 business hours of receiving SolarAPP+ approval documents. Separately, inspection requests received before 4:00pm are scheduled for the next workday; requests after 4:00pm are scheduled 2 days later.
